leadText:
Max (Japanese: マサト Masato) is a character of the day who appeared in Maxxed Out!. He is a doppelgänger of Max and as such shares the same name, both in English and Japanese, and character design.
 ]]
He confronted the group at a lakeside Pokémon Center, demanding they keep it down after May's Skitty was proving too energetic. The blue-haired Max replied back, and an argument quickly broke out. Tensions between the pair quickly escalated after they realized they were both named Max. Nurse Joy broke it up, so Max went down to the lake to clear his head. 

Later, May and Max followed after a wild directly to the brown-haired Max's location. Another fight started, though and the others called out their Pokémon as a distraction tactic. The two Max began to bond over their common love for Pokémon. Blue-haired Max then said he got to see them every day, and that his father is a Gym Leader, making the other Max impressed.

May showed off Skitty to and . Soon thereafter, jumped from the bushes and surprised everyone. After their mecha exploded, sending Team Rocket blasting off, the two Max became friends. The brown-haired one intended to train his new friend hard, and one day become a Pokémon Trainer.
